name: Kiel Serian
source:
Star Sign: Libra
Hobby: Reading
Special Skill: Speed Reading
Likes: Magical Research
Dislikes: Unclear Things, Food's Made with Milk
Treasure: A Magic Book inherited from his mother

[url=/c45887]Aish's[/url] younger twin brother.
A new magician who does experiments and research at the Magic Research Institute.
He likes being alone and doesn't like getting involved with other people.
He summoned [url=/c45873]Mei[/url] to the magical world during a failed experiment, so he volunteers to be in charge of looking after her.
